sentences.text:
--- 
For the Petitioner: M/s Anmol Deepak, Rishu Ranjan, Himanshu Harsh, Advocates For the O.P-State: Ms. Mohua Palit, A.P.P.
---
I.A. No. 3516 of 2024 07 / 15.04.2024 This interlocutory application has been filed to bring the surrender certificate of the petitioner on record.

Surrender certificate dated 04.04.2024 has been filed which shows that the petitioner who was released on provisional bail for appearing in Class-XII Eam, has surrendered before the Additional Sessions Judge-III-cum-Special Judge, C.B.I-Special Judge (Crime against Women)-cum-Special Judge, Commercial Court, Dhanbad.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-III-cum-Special Judge, C.B.I-Special Judge (Crime against Women)-cum-Special Judge, Commercial Court, Dhanbad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In view of the above, the instant I.A. stands disposed of.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Dhansar P.S. Case No. 219 of 2023 for the offences registered under sections 376(D)/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of Sri Manoj Kumar Indwar, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Dhanbad.
3. On 01.11.2023, victim was gangraped by the accused persons namely, Vipin Singh and Bittu.
Petitioner was also summoned by co-accused persons and asked to rape the victim.

However,
petitioner refused to do so.

4. Considering the aforesaid facts, petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri Manoj Kumar Indwar, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class,
Dhanbad in connection with Dhansar P.S. Case No. 219 of 2023.
